slots_and_copies.name: sector_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Ring of 10 rotating 0x1000 sectors. Loader (FUN_08048dd0) reads sectors 0..9, keeps those with magic SONIC_PB and checksum match, selects the one with the largest 64-bit sequence counter at +8; writer (FUN_08049644) writes sector (seq-1)%10. Sampled files only populate sectors 0-1; sectors 2-9 are 0xFF.

checksums.name: header_sum4_be
checksums.formula_detail: s=(b[0]+b[1]+b[2]+b[3])&0xFFFF (=sum of 'SONI'=0x53+0x4F+0x4E+0x49=0x0139 for every valid copy, since magic is constant); stored BIG-ENDIAN: byte at 0xFFE=s>>8, byte at 0xFFF=s&0xFF. FUN_0804971c loops exactly 4 bytes from the save-struct base. This is a near-constant magic-derived check word, NOT a payload integrity check: sequence, config, field_0x014 and all score bytes are outside the covered range (full-block sum 0xD2C7/0xD2C8 does not match stored). Algorithm enum says sum16_le for the accumulation; storage byte order is BE as detailed here.

io_driver_functions.notes: Flash identify: writes 0xAA@0x5555,0x55@0x2AAA,0x90 (ID entry), reads maker/device bytes via FUN_080608a8 from flash base 0x0E000000, then 0xF0 reset (twice). AgbFlash-style.

IdentifyFlash wrapper: sets WAITCNT bits (|3), calls FUN_0805ff48, scans flash-type table (entry+0x28 name/id field) and copies the matched 0x14-byte device descriptor to globals. Returns matched flag used by FUN_08048d98.
Copies the RAM-resident flash driver stub from ROM to a stack/RAM buffer (driver is executed from RAM, hence UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE thunks at 0x08060894-0x080608d0).

ReadFlash(sector, offset, dst, size): flash addr = (sector << device_shift) + offset + 0x0E000000; via thunk FUN_080608a0. Loader always calls (sector,0,ram_buf,0x1000). 128KB parts (size word==0x20000) first switch bank via FUN_0805ff24.
WriteFlash/ProgramFlash(sector, src_ram, size): flash addr=(sector<<shift)+0x0E000000; via thunk FUN_080608a0. Save paths always write the full 0x1000 struct.

EraseFlashSector(sector): only for sector<0x10; unlock 0xAA/0x55, command 0x80, unlock again, 0x30 at sector address; polls via FUN_080608a0. No direct static caller in callgraph - reached through the RAM-driver thunk layer (FUN_0806089c pre-write step).
Single-byte/word flash program helper: unlock, 0xA0 program command, writes one unit, verifies via FUN_080608a0. Not used by the 0x1000 save path (static-only).
Selects flash type/timeout profile (called with type=3 and an out-pointer before every save/init write). Name-level semantics HYPOTHESIS; call pattern CONFIRMED_STATIC.
RAM-driver thunk invoked up to 3 times before WriteFlash; on success (returns 0) the write proceeds. Erase-and/or-verify step (exact opcode unrecovered - jumptable into RAM copy).
RAM-driver thunk called once per sector 0..9 during factory init (FUN_080492e8). Per-sector erase/prepare step (HYPOTHESIS on exact opcode).
sum16 of save-struct bytes [0,4); see checksums[0].
BIOS SWI 0x0B (CpuSet) wrapper used as memcpy to stage score tables between the RAM working table (+0x1E0) and the save struct (+0x22C), 8 units per entry x 20 entries x 4 tables.
Builds factory-default score tables in the RAM working buffer: 4 tables x 20 entries, score=1000000000-50000000*i (64-bit pair), name chars at entry+8.
Default/factory save-struct initialiser: clears struct, writes magic, seq=1, field_0x014=100, config defaults, score tables, checksum.
LoadSave: scans sectors 0..9, validates magic+checksum, selects max sequence, stages scores/config/byte-arrays into RAM mirrors, then calls FUN_08049d50.

SaveGame: increments 64-bit sequence, recomputes checksum, sector=(seq-1)%10 (FUN_08060ef8 64-bit modulo), FUN_0806000c(3,..), up to 3 attempts of FUN_0806089c then FUN_08060300 write of 0x1000 bytes.
64-bit division/modulo helper; used as (seq-1) mod 10 to choose the ring sector. Not a checksum - listed to prevent misclassification.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Sector rejected by loader magic compare (FUN_08048dd0); game falls back to the older valid sector (sector0, seq=1) instead of factory reset, because one valid copy remains

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Corrupt checksum bytes at sector+0xFFE in the newest sector only
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Sector rejected (FUN_0804971c()!=stored BE word); fallback to older sector. Proves checksum is actually consulted

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set newest sector sequence low word to 0 (or raise the older sector's sequence above the newest)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: No checksum repair needed (sequence is outside covered [0,4) range - key prediction). Loader selection flips to the sector now holding the largest sequence; observable as older/newer progress being loaded

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Raise score_table_0 entry0 score (sector newest, 0x1000+0x22C) from 1000000000 to e.g. 2000000000

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change score_table_0 entry0 name 'SON'->'XXX' in newest sector
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Edited name displayed in score table; no checksum repair needed (same coverage argument)
